surface.background: fully opaque deep navy environment based on #10151D
surface.alternate: desaturated blue-slate distance field based on #263445
surface.finish: tactile practical-set atmosphere with broad tonal fields and low film grain

palette_roles.environment: deep navy based on #10151D remains the dominant field
palette_roles.distance: desaturated blue-slate based on #263445 and #596C85 separates atmospheric planes
palette_roles.subject: a matte mineral subject based on #D6DEE6 carries the single metaphor
palette_roles.thesis_accent: one amber cue based on #E59A3A supplies the only warm emphasis
palette_roles.shadow: near-black blue based on #090D12 preserves depth without crushed detail

line_language.primary: silhouette and edge-light define the subject without diagram outlines
line_language.paths: one restrained warm path or seam may carry the thesis when confirmed
line_language.boundaries: broad environmental planes replace cards grids panels and technical frames

material_and_texture.surface: matte plaster paper stone or mineral surfaces with visible tactile restraint
material_and_texture.objects: one substantial practical-set sculpture rather than glossy products floating icons or stock scenery
material_and_texture.finish: low film grain and subtle surface variation with no chrome glass plastic sparkle or oversharpening

geometry.projection: restrained 50 mm cinematic perspective with a stable horizon and no fisheye distortion
geometry.subject: one coherent symbolic subject with a strong silhouette and no competing metaphor
geometry.environment: foreground midground and background remain legible as large atmospheric fields
geometry.focal_rule: very low symbolic density keeps one subject and one amber thesis cue dominant

depth_and_camera.mode: restrained 50 mm cinematic perspective with controlled depth and no extreme wide-angle spectacle
depth_and_camera.layers: three readable distance planes use desaturated blue value separation rather than invented scenery
depth_and_camera.lighting: one cool ambient fill and a single motivated amber practical light with one coherent shadow direction
depth_and_camera.atmosphere: subtle haze appears only where motivated light passes through space and never obscures the subject

typography.voice: quiet editorial serif or restrained sans-serif applied deterministically outside image generation
typography.exact_text: titles captions and labels are added only after article semantics are confirmed
typography.generated_text: image generation contains no readable text logos plaques interfaces or symbols

density_and_spacing.density: very low symbolic density with one subject and minimal supporting environment
density_and_spacing.spacing: broad negative space and one intentional title-safe field preserve editorial hierarchy
density_and_spacing.occupancy: the metaphor occupies roughly sixty-five to seventy-eight percent without becoming a tiny object in empty darkness

required_traits: fully opaque deep navy atmosphere remains readable rather than crushed black
restrained 50 mm cinematic perspective and stable horizon preserve practical-set credibility
one matte mineral subject carries one nameable metaphor through a strong silhouette
a single motivated amber practical light or cue guides the eye without decorative glow
very low symbolic density and broad editorial negative space prevent collage and spectacle drift
forbidden_traits: no generic glowing portal cosmic sky fantasy city floating orb hologram or unrelated cinematic spectacle
no default face lone person crowd hands character silhouette or human drama used as a conceptual shortcut
no neon circuitry transparent glass chrome glossy product render rainbow grading or multiple warm accents
no dashboard infographic card grid node-box system blueprint construction or isometric infrastructure grammar
no generated title labels logos interface screens article claims or copied golden metaphor topology
no muddy crushed-black field excessive fog excessive grain empty darkness or illegible subject

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 6 uses tactile matte practical-set objects one symbolic thesis and a single motivated amber practical light; Style 3 uses emissive circuitry transparent or luminous systems multiple relationships and neon technological atmosphere

Style 6 uses restrained cinematic perspective environmental depth and one metaphor; Style 5 uses fixed isometric projection repeated infrastructure modules explicit operational paths and architectural-system readability
Style 6 is dark atmosphere-led tactile and depth-driven; Style 1 is bright flat geometric grid-led and explanatory
